instagramCaption:
NASA's Deep Space 1 embarked on a groundbreaking mission. \\[Deep Space 1 (DS1) was launched by NASA to explore the asteroid belt and test advanced technologies. The spacecraft flew by an asteroid and a comet, part of the New Millennium Program. One surprising detail: DS1 used ion propulsion, a revolutionary technology at the time. \\This mission paved the way for future space exploration with innovative tech. \\What do you think was the most exciting technology tested on DS1? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
